context: Interactive data visualization — an icicle chart (hierarchical partition layout) of a synthetic file system, linked to a brushable log-scale histogram for filtering by file size.
first_impression: A deliberately designed, cohesive explorer with a colorblind-safe Tol palette, clear typographic hierarchy, and satisfying linked interactions between the icicle and histogram.
what_works: The Paul Tol palette is a genuine design choice — lighter tones for parent directories and saturated fills for leaves create an immediate depth cue; the header badge, breadcrumb links, and histogram bars all share the same blue (#4477AA), giving the whole piece visual unity. Typography is intentionally hierarchical: title at 17px/600, hint text at 12px/muted, axis labels quieter still.
what_doesnt: The root 'project' row renders as a large flat gray band occupying roughly 20% of the icicle height with almost no information content — a layout inefficiency that wastes scarce vertical space. The histogram uses a single flat blue for all bars with no connection to the icicle's categorical palette, a missed opportunity to reinforce the color system across both views.
